headline.text: Open ideas when brainstorming, tighter scope when building

observations.text: In brainstorming, the user invited five ideas and asked for a playful tone.
In implementation, after choosing one idea, the user asked the assistant to stay within that scope until it works.
During a failed retry, the user asked the assistant to follow two conditions already given. The assistant had left one out.

interpretation.text: Within these records, the user may invite breadth when exploring and ask for narrower, constraint-following help when building or fixing. The thanks after a repair hints that a clearer next step mattered then.

alternative: The firmer wording in the retry may come mainly from the assistant's omission, not from the stage of work. The scope request may also reflect just this one task.
limitation: These records don't show the assistant's replies, the content of the two conditions, or the user's tone elsewhere. The rude line was labeled story dialogue, so it says nothing about their own tone.
